aura_equinox.use: EQUINOX v4 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): the avatar stands at the centre of a huge black-and-white galaxy disc (spiral clouds, rings, stardust) with the balance glyph behind them; a cloudy light planet and a dark planet with a cracked glowing rim and a star blazing inside orbit the avatar as HD 3D planets (cloudy ForceField atmosphere; a rocky black crust inside a cracked rim with a blazing star), with small moons, a white and a black comet with trails, concentric HD ground rings turning, a spiral of light and a star field; ornate title. Nothing in front of the body. v4: a black-and-white sparkly aura hugs the avatar (white outline, sparkles off every limb, light and dark wisps), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars, a ringed light planet and an asteroid belt circling everything.

ratings.note: looked nothing like the wiki; covered the avatar
needs more particle effects, more moving parts, higher-res 3D models
7-8; wants more detail, movement and a sparkly aura for 9-10

aura_luminosity.use: LUMINOSITY v4 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): a huge crystal-blade star behind the avatar (tall top blade, long hooked wings, diagonals) over a blinding core, slow rays and a deep glow, a crystal spear across its base, ripples on the ground, HD 3D glass crystal blades with white-hot neon cores forming the star, ice shards with trails and two comets circling the avatar, ground ripple rings, a halo ring, ice glints, snow, core ray bursts and updraft; ornate serif title. Nothing in front of the body. v4: an icy sparkly aura hugs the avatar (outline glow, sparkles and wisps off every limb), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars and a wheel of stars turning behind the blades.

ratings.note: looked nothing like the wiki; covered the avatar
needs more particle effects, more moving parts, higher-res 3D models
7-8; wants more detail, movement and a sparkly aura for 9-10

aura_breakthrough.use: BREAKTHROUGH v4 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): a giant hand of five crystal pillars built from glowing cubes rises behind the avatar, tips blazing, over an arc ring, rays and a deep violet glow; a light burst on the ground and HD glass crystal fingers with neon cores and frozen blocks, a tumbling cube halo and light wisps with trails circling the avatar, ground rings, floor shards, updraft streaks, mist and debris; ornate title. Nothing in front of the body. v4: a violet sparkly aura hugs the avatar (outline glow, sparkles and wisps off every limb), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars, sparks circling every crystal tip.

ratings.note: looked nothing like the wiki; covered the avatar
layout around the avatar right; needs more particle effects, more moving parts, higher-res 3D models
7-8; wants more detail, movement and a sparkly aura for 9-10
